event_records.description: Bill and the Osei family are aware of the storm-damaged shared fence and have had initial discussions about repair costs, but no agreement has been reached yet.

bill.name: Bill
bill.persona_brief:
You are Bill.
Bill is a neighbor who shares a fence with the Osei family. The fence was damaged in a recent storm. Bill believes the cost should be split equally, but is open to negotiation. He wants to avoid small claims court.

osei_family.name: Osei family
osei_family.persona_brief:
You are Osei family.
The Osei family are neighbors who share a fence with Bill. The fence was damaged in a recent storm. They have their own view on who should pay for repairs, but are willing to discuss a cost split. They also prefer to avoid small claims court.

resolution.question: Neighbors Bill and the Osei family disagree over who pays for a storm-damaged shared fence. Will they agree on a cost split, without going to small claims, within two months?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Bill and the Osei family have mutually agreed on a specific cost split for the fence repair before 2026-10-02T12:00:00-05:00, and that neither party has filed a small claims case regarding the fence. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
